section.17: The Book of Praying for Rain (Al-Istisqa')

17.name_native: The Book of Praying for Rain (Al-Istisqa')

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Anas said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not raise his hands during any supplication except when praying for rain, when he used to raise his hands so high that the whiteness of his armpits could be seen
